digest.component_or_area: GitHub Actions CI workflow - gerrit-verify golden-path job
propositions: The golden-path job in gerrit-verify.yaml unconditionally runs apt-get update and install jq on every run, causing 15-30s overhead even when jq is pre-installed on ubuntu-latest runners.
A conditional check using 'type jq' can detect pre-installed jq in under 0.001s and skip apt-get update when unnecessary, while safely falling back to package installation on minimal runners.
The change replaces the unconditional apt-get command with a conditional fallback: type jq >/dev/null 2>&1 || (sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y jq) && jq --version.
All acceptance criteria including lint, typecheck, verify gate parity, and pytest test suite pass after the change.
